response_caveat: Kernels can differ materially: uncorrected flux pulls are descriptive, not a same-flux goodness-of-fit test. No response correction or error rescaling applied.
limitations: Streaming two-object pilot with metadata-selected repeats; incomplete data are not population or absolute accuracy.
Conditional pull denominator assumes independent supplied noise, omits common morphology/calibration/PSF/background uncertainty.
Kernel differences from declared SEDs are diagnostics, not empirical galaxy priors or corrections.
Agreement cannot expose shared biases; response similarity is not equality.
Two comparisons in a channel share a baseline and are statistically dependent; no binomial coverage or independence claim.
Do not fit arbitrary error multipliers to make this small sample pass.
